'''Rich Jeffery ONE-ARM's Type II Senators of DEATH''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Rich Jeffery]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18751">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18751 ONE-ARM's Type II Senators of DEATH], DeckTech (Rich "ONE-ARM" Jeffery, 2 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18751/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18751/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rich Jeffery]]
* '''Published:''' 2 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ONE-ARM's Type II Senators of DEATH''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif|label=My Lord, Is That Legal?}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Start Your Engines!|Tat-D-startyourengines.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Begin Landing Your Troops|Cor-D-beginlandingyourtroops.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Legal Jeffery DS 2001 18751.txt |Download]] (omits Control (Dark) (Coruscant): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' This deck Flips First Turn and Kills whatever the opponent drops down.

== Original post ==

'''ONE-ARM's Type II Senators of DEATH'''
* '''Author:''' Rich "ONE-ARM" Jeffery
* '''Published:''' September 2, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck Flips First Turn and Kills whatever the opponent drops down.

=== Strategy ===

Check out my newer verion of this deck with SAC. Also check out my LS deck which has NEVER lost a podrace.

This is a Closed Environment Decjk so I don't want any reveiws Like ”WTF no Vader??”

Alright. First Turn Fart on Ani's PodFlip if you can (most of the time you can).

Why no Watto's Box Too Risky in Closed. It's a game winner but some LS decks jsut pack too many Interrupts. One deck I played had 5 A Step BAckwards. Which was insane.

Drop maul and he's a god with The phantom MEnace out.

Nute is a good 4 ability guy 3 destiny.

If I had them I would put a third Phantom menace in and a 4th MAul strikes. Just Cuz I could.

Why 2 Porn Frees Cuz he's great to drop with maul to add a destiny

Against Hyperdrive, Drop maul into the shop since he's immune to attrition.

Against Senators Hodl the senate, Adding Battle Destinies when you can. LS Senators is much weaker than DS.

Pretty Simple. REad the cards adn you can paly the deck. This deck can be palyed by a trained Monkey (Why yes my brother HAS played this deck.)
